T: Bush tucker meets the big smoke.
D: A legendary bushman from the Top End takes on New York.
P: Pour a beer when Mick first sees a bidet in the hotel.
S: scored belly skin dried overnight, salted hard and roasted until it puffs, cut into shards
Score pork belly skin, dry uncovered in the fridge overnight, salt heavily, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C for 40 until it puffs and crackles. Cut into shards.
King prawns with garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers
King prawns marinated in garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil, skewered and grilled hot for 90 seconds a side, lemon myrtle butter brushed on at the end.
Seasoned minced beef in gravy, shortcrust base and puff pastry lid

Mince cooked with onion, Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock, thickened, cooled, baked in shortcrust bases with puff lids at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 500g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml stock, thicken and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: Barramundi fillets skin scored and dried, grilled skin down until crisp, flipped for 1 minute, brought out with a big hunting knife.

Barramundi fillets skin scored and dried, grilled skin down until crisp, flipped for 1 minute, brought out with a big hunting knife. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.
Thin rump seared hard, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, a fried egg, beetroot, tomato, lettuce, cheese and barbecue sauce.
W: Butter sponge squares dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in coconut
Butter sponge cut into squares, dipped in thin chocolate icing (icing sugar, cocoa, butter, milk), rolled in desiccated coconut.
K: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
Dark rum floated over lime and ginger beer on ice

Dark rum poured over ice and spicy ginger beer with plenty of fresh lime, in a tall frosty glass. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate and skewer the prawns up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; grill just before serving

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the prawns with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until just cooked, turning once.
Melt the butter with the lemon myrtle and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate and skewer the haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill fresh

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the haloumi with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until golden on both sides, turning once.
Melt the butter with the lemon myrtle and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; assemble and bake on the day, or bake up to 1 day ahead and reheat at 180C

steps.text: Brown the mince with the diced onion, then add Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock. Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little water.
Cool the filling completely.
Line patty tins with shortcrust, fill, and top with puff lids.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil filling up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; assemble and bake on the day, or freeze the baked pies for up to 1 month

steps.text: Fry the diced onion and mushrooms in the oil until well browned.
Add the lentils, soy, tomato sauce and stock. Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little water.
Cool the filling completely.
Line patty tins with shortcrust, fill, and top with puff lids.
Bake at 200C until golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; score the skin and pat dry up to 4 hours ahead, uncovered in the fridge

steps.text: Score the skin of the barramundi fillets, pat very dry and brush with the oil.
Grill skin down over high heat for about 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.
Melt the butter with the garlic and lemon myrtle, spoon over the fish and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; crush the garlic and measure out the butter and lemon myrtle up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply in a criss cross and brush with the oil and salt.
Grill cut side down over medium high heat until charred, then flip and cook until soft right through.
Melt the butter with the garlic and lemon myrtle, spoon over the eggplant and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.
Cut the sponge into squares.
Whisk the icing sugar, cocoa, butter and milk into a thin icing.
Dip each square, drain and roll in coconut.
Set on a rack.

dishes.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
dishes.make_ahead: Best built to order; squeeze the lime juice up to 1 day ahead and keep the ginger beer chilled

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

af.make_ahead: Brew, sweeten and chill the dark tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove it, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the dark tea over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

s.note: King prawns with garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers
s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, lemon zest and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill hot for 90 seconds a side. Brush with 50g butter melted with 1 tsp lemon myrtle and serve with lemon.

s.note: Seasoned minced beef in gravy, shortcrust base and puff pastry lid
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml stock, thicken and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Barramundi fillets skin scored and dried, grilled skin down until crisp, flipped for 1 minute, brought out with a big hunting knife.
m.how: Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.

w.note: Butter sponge squares dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in coconut
w.how: Cut a 500g butter sponge into 16 squares. Whisk 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g melted butter and 150ml milk into a thin icing. Dip each square, drain and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack for an hour.
